purpose: First comprehensive security-scan baseline. Use path mapping in docs/security-scanning.md to scan only changed attack surface; do not treat scanner output as proof.

tools.cargo_audit: unavailable: host lacks a C linker; Rust dependency coverage used OSV/Trivy instead

validated_as_not_issues.note: Gitleaks private-key/API-key hits are intentional test keys, mock credentials, or .env.example placeholders; no real credential leak was confirmed.
No dangerous HTML sink was found in web/src or app/src during targeted search; log rendering still requires review whenever rendering changes.
No unsafe Rust blocks/functions, transmute, or direct libc use found in crates during targeted search.
Production build plans use argv vectors; Mongo backup shell wrapper is constant-script and passes user values positionally.
Reviewed grep hits were static/test SQL; no dynamic production SQL injection was confirmed.
crates/node/src/tree.rs already validates relative paths, rejects .git/unsupported entries, avoids following symlinks, and has hostile archive tests.

PKCE S256, exact redirects, hashed client secrets, token rotation/reuse revocation, browser-admin consent, and bounded delegated keys are implemented; MCP invocation internals should be re-reviewed when changed.
